verifications.claim: Rocky Carroll left NCIS as a series regular.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Vance is gone and NCIS will never be the same again." (R1); "Director Leon Vance... going gentle into that good night." (R2); "Director Leon Vance has left the "NCIS" building" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm Vance's character death, ending Carroll's role as series regular.

verifications.claim: Rocky Carroll's character is Director Leon Vance.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "his character, Director Leon Vance" (R1); "Director Leon Vance, portrayed by Rocky Carroll" (R2); "Director Leon Vance (played by... Rocky Carroll)" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: All sources explicitly identify Rocky Carroll as playing Director Leon Vance.

verifications.claim: Director Leon Vance was killed off in the 500th episode of NCIS.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "death of his character... NCIS's 500th episode" (R1); "big surprise of the show’s 500th episode... Director Leon Vance" (R2); "killing NCIS boss Vance... 500th episode" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated across sources that Vance dies in the 500th episode.

verifications.claim: The 500th episode of NCIS aired on March 24, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Published Mar 24, 2026... NCIS season 23, episode 13 (500th) (R1); "Tuesday night" (March 24, 2026 context) (R2); "March 24 500th episode" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Sources publish date and explicitly state March 24 as air date for 500th episode.

verifications.claim: Rocky Carroll exited NCIS after 18 seasons.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "through his 18 seasons" (R2); "for 18 seasons and 392 episodes" (R3); "18 years after the leader's debut in season five" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Consistently stated he was on for 18 seasons before exit.

verifications.claim: Rocky Carroll confirmed it was not his choice.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "he “was not the catalyst for this happening" (R6); "I was not the catalyst for this happening" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Direct quotes from Carroll confirming producers' decision, not his.

verifications.claim: Rocky Carroll supported the creative decision to end Vance's story.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "how quickly I was able to come to terms with it... ‘Really, that is actually a great story'" (R1); "I really think it’s a great episode... what a way to go" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Carroll repeatedly expresses acceptance and praise for the storyline.

verifications.claim: The 500th episode of NCIS is titled "All Good Things."
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "NCIS season 23, episode 13, "All Good Things" (R1); "episode titled, "All Good Things," (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Explicit title confirmation for the 500th episode.

verifications.claim: Director Leon Vance was shot by a corrupt CID agent.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "CID Agent Dolan Thompson... fires three times into Vance's chest" (R3); "shot to death by a corrupt agent" (R6); "shot by a corrupt agent" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources detail shooting by corrupt CID agent.

verifications.claim: "It was basically presented to me that the studio and the network wanted to do something really spectacular, really big."
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "the studio, the network... Let’s do something spectacular for the 500th episode" (R2); similar phrasing in R4 and R8
verifications.reasoning: Close paraphrase of Carroll's recounting of producers' pitch, but not exact quote.

verifications.claim: Executive producer Steven D. Binder revealed to Variety that they wanted to create a "love letter to the character" and shake up the NCIS universe.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "a real love letter to the character" (R2, Variety); "turns the NCIS universe upside down" (R7, quoting Binder)
verifications.reasoning: "Love letter" directly from Variety interview; "shake up" similar to shock/upside down ideas attributed to Binder.

verifications.claim: Rocky Carroll will continue to work on the NCIS series as a director.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "already has returned to the set to film an episode" (R2); "will return to direct an upcoming Season 24 episode" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple confirmations of continued directing role.

verifications.claim: Rocky Carroll has directed 25+ episodes of NCIS already.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.claim: Rocky Carroll joined NCIS in Season 5.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "18 years after the leader's debut in season five" (R4); "joined the show in Season 5" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated he joined in Season 5.

verifications.claim: Rocky Carroll became a regular in Season 6 of NCIS.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "recurring role before getting bumped to series regular in Season 6"
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation of becoming regular in Season 6.
